summary: Live bb via non-destructive dev install (dockside-dev, /tmp path source; git install untouched), sidebar.threadListProvider=dockside-dev/inbox. Dark sidebar shows repo favicons rendered for 5 projects (rn-opencv OC, cv-supa SU etc. are favicon.svg files) and letter badges PW/MA for projects without icons. One-letter mode collapses to P/M and recolors (letter-keyed color). Icons-off + two letters yields RO/RD/CS/CH/MA matching multi-word initial derivation. Settings declared server-side, applied live. AC-6 fail-closed paths unit-tested. Live light shot blocked by macOS appearance permission; mockup-light.png (same derivation+palette code) evidences light rendering. Re-recorded at current tree after version bump + lockfile sync.
